name: crab-buddy
description: A pixel crab with a life of its own on a little beach above the prompt: real sky, seasons and weather, a sea that shows your context, costume beaches, unlockable decor, a friend, tool-mirroring props, a fishing line for each subagent, an optional single crab that roams between your windows, big moments for commits and tests, signs it holds up for news, needs you care for and break reminders.

longTaskSeconds.title: Long task (seconds)
longTaskSeconds.description: A turn at least this long ends with a wave, a toast and a chirp; 0 turns it off

breakMinutes.title: Break reminder (minutes)
breakMinutes.description: Minutes of continuous work before the crab suggests a break; 0 turns it off

sound.title: Done chirp
sound.description: Play a short chirp when a long task finishes

bubbles.title: Speech bubbles
bubbles.description: How often the crab talks on its own; your care actions always get a reply unless off

weatherPlace.title: Weather place
weatherPlace.description: Whose real weather shows on the beach (rain, snow, wind). A city name: its name and coordinates go to open-meteo.com once an hour. "auto": your time zone's city instead (e.g. Europe/Berlin is Berlin). "auto-ip": your city by IP lookup at ipwho.is, which sees your IP address, every 3 hours. Empty: no weather is fetched.

signs.title: Signs
signs.description: The crab holds up signs for news: a task done, a coffee break, a walk, commits, pushes, PRs and MRs. Off: bubbles and toasts carry it.
